subject: [PATCH bpf-next 1/3] bpf, cgroup: Don't read freed effective arrays in BPF_PROG_QUERY

2026-11-12.patch_summary: This patch fixes a use-after-free bug in the BPF_PROG_QUERY function by checking if the cgroup's bpf reference count is zero before accessing its effective arrays. If it is, the function returns -ENOENT to indicate that the cgroup has been removed. This prevents reading freed memory and ensures data integrity.
